opportunities.name: Book unit note: Gutenberg + IMDb lookup, logged to Notes
opportunities.description: For a given book title, find it on Project Gutenberg (author, downloads), find the film on IMDb (year, rating), and add a combined 'Unit:' note in Notes.
steps: Search the title on Project Gutenberg and open the top result
Record the author and download count
Search the same title on IMDb and open the matching film
Record the release year and rating
Open Notes, type 'Unit: <title> by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>' and press Enter
